title: Meadow's Clean Dirt
body:
This resource pack **overhauls common ground blocks** such as Grass Blocks, Dirt, Dirt Paths, Mycelium, Coarse Dirt, Rooted Dirt, and Podzol.
By **reducing harsh pixel contrast**, landscapes appear **significantly smoother** and more harmonious, while **staying faithful to the original vanilla Minecraft** style.
